title: Dispatch: annotation is done for now; the picture route waits on a vocabulary review, the picture-text statistics review and a label-position map
statement: Evidence for language has to come from outside the text's statistics (P-G-007, P-G-009), and the drawings are the route. Status: every PIC folio offered so far (f66r, f67r2, f68r1, f70v2, f72r3, f72v1, f72v2, f72v3, f73r, f73v, f75v, f99r) has blind annotations from three or more seats on the record or on branches, and none is AGREED. Across the 21 scored pairs, seats agree on object kind 90% of the time but on free-text feature values only 35%, so the agreement measure, not the annotators, is the bottleneck. Three things now unblock the route, and none of them is more annotation: (1) review the closed feature vocabulary and ring convention (branch M-L4-picture-vocab-fleet-fable) and re-annotate with it; (2) review the picture-text statistics (branch code-P-L4-013-fleet-opus: picture_label with same_object_label, feature_label_share, label_in_page_text, null shuffle_picture_labels, refusing below 20 AGREED labelled objects); (3) take the label-position-map step (M-L4, fleet-opus): a seat that did not annotate a folio records where each label line sits, so ring labels can be joined to figures by position. Two folios already give labels tied without a position map: f75v (ten tags on drawn lines) and f73r/f73v (four figures in a row above the circle, one word each, ids f73x.1-.4). Until AGREED objects exist, the picture-text facts cannot be registered.
check: None: a dispatch. Sources: registry picture items V-001..V-021; branches M-L4-picture-vocab-fleet-fable, code-P-L4-013-fleet-opus, M-L4-fleet-opus; PIC-f73r and PIC-f73v annotations.
